title: Megurine Luka — From The Watchtower〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wow...
You can see so far from on top of the fire tower♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Now we're definitely gonna find that ninja thief!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, let's start looking!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Let's do our best.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Still, this is such an expansive park.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And I'm amazed by how it really feels like we've been sent back in time to the Edo period.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I couldn't believe it either the first time we arrived♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's that bridge!
Until yesterday, that's where we did a part of our performances!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, if you go straight down that street, there's a place for the horsies to rest.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehehe♪ The way you're talking makes it sound like you've been living here for years, Emu.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Because you already know so much about this place♪ You sound like a princess who grew up here.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? I do?
Hehe. Thanks, that makes me really happy♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If I were the princess, then I'd make every day a festival!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that sounds wonderful.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Also, if you were the princess, then does that mean Tsukasa and Rui would've been daimyos?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And Nene would've been the tea shop girl everybody adores.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, maybe!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, Luka, what would you and the others be?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Us?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Now I'm wondering what you, Miku and everybody else would've been like during the Edo period.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO's really mature and reliable, so I bet she would've made a great noble♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Yes, that would suit her very well.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But also KAITO since he's always there to lead us down the right path.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <However, they're both great at sword fighting, so they may've been samurai back then...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean!
Either way would be so cool...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <As for Rin and Len, I have a feeling that they would've run a dango shop together.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that means they could've been working with Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And Miku would've been an acrobat, right...?
Rui even said that there were people called tumblers and stuff back then!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I actually think Miku would've done well as an evil magistrate.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What? Miku? As an evil magistrate?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, for example...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ah, MEIKO.
Are these the “souvenirs” you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. You naughty girl♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! She would make a good villain...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, Luka, what would you have been?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Me?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hmm... Which occupation would be best...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that person's carrying a katana and a rather odd-looking weapon. What's his job...?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you mean his jitte?
He's a constable, like a police officer from back then!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Then, I'd like to be one of those.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <There seem to be a lot of them, so I could probably take naps in the back without anybody waking me up.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
N-No, you'd get into so much trouble!
You're supposed to be protecting the city!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, wait... But in your case, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Detective
rows.Line:
No, Luka!
You can't fall asleep here! It isn't safe!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Oh, good morning♪

rows.Speaker: Detective
rows.Line: Honestly...
se_run_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Perpetrator
rows.Line:
Phew... I think I lost them... What?
They sent somebody to wait for me here? But I'm so far from the center of town.

rows.Speaker: Detective
rows.Line: Huh...? Hey, you're the one who stole those dango!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe. I had a feeling that he'd show up around here.

rows.Speaker: Detective
rows.Line: Y-You did?! That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Perpetrator
rows.Line:
Argh! You leave me no choice!
Prepare yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's our line! Hiyah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Phew... That solves that, yes?

rows.Speaker: Detective
rows.Line:
Luka...
Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm just glad that nobody got hurt...
Anyway, take our thief away for me... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Detective
rows.Line: She fell asleep again...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-That would be so cool...!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You'd be such a cool sword master, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You think so?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, Emu, look...
That ninja over there...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <He seems to be running while trying to stay hidden.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Thanks, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hello, Nene?!
If you keep walking straight ahead, you'll see...
